items.title: Tamil Nadu government bans smartphones inside 52 major  temples
items.summary: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The Tamil Nadu government has banned devotees from carrying smartphones inside 52 temples across the state, with the restriction coming into effect on Tuesday, September 1. The Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) department issued the order as part of measures to prevent devotees from taking photographs and videos inside temple premises. HR&CE Minister Ramesh announced the restriction on Tuesday, saying devotees who need to carry their smartphones inside the temples will have to pay a fee of Rs 5 per phone. Lockers will be provided at the temples for devotees who choose to deposit their phones. Phones without cameras will be allowed inside the temples without any restrictions. According to the minister, the measure has been introduced to ensure a peaceful environment for devotees while they pray. The HR&CE department clarified that the Rs 5 fee is not intended to generate revenue and will instead be used to manage the lockers and related infrastructure.
